about.title: I build products, not just code
about.subtitle: A product mindset combined with technical excellence
description: I started as a traditional developer obsessed with clean code and best practices. But I quickly realized that beautiful architecture without user impact is just technical debt. That shift changed everything.

Now, I approach every project with a product mindset. I work directly with founders and product teams to understand the core problem, validate solutions, and scale what works. Every decision—architecture, design, features—is made in service of user outcomes.

I specialize in building MVPs that validate ideas quickly, then scaling them for growth. Whether it's React web apps, React Native mobile, or GraphQL APIs, I build with performance and scalability in mind.
I'm particularly excited about products at the intersection of great design and solid engineering. That's where real magic happens—and where I love to work.

projects.title: Featured Projects
React Native E-commerce App - Thriftverse
projects.description: Thriftverse is a thrift marketplace platform where users can create their own online stores and get a unique storefront URL to sell curated products.
projects.longDescription: Thriftverse is a modern thrift marketplace platform where users can create their own online stores and get a unique storefront URL to sell curated products. The platform includes a buyer-facing web app with secure eSewa checkout, and a store-owner mobile app where influencers or sellers can sign up, manage their store, and share their custom subdomain. Thriftverse also handles logistics through Nepal Can Move (NCM), including order tracking, shipping coordination, and automated email notifications for both buyers and store owners.

projects.title: Clinic Management System - Cannabiz Elite (Australia)
projects.description: Cannabiz Elite is a clinic management system purpose-built for Australian cannabis and telehealth clinics
projects.longDescription: Cannabiz Elite is a clinic management system purpose-built for Australian cannabis and telehealth clinics. Unlike generic practice management software designed for GPs or specialists, the platform understands the unique operational needs of medicinal cannabis providers. From scheduling and telehealth through to prescription management and dispensary coordination, every feature is tailored to cannabis clinic workflows. This isn't a generic system retrofitted for cannabis — it's cannabis clinic management from the ground up.

projects.title: The LYVE app
projects.description: The Lyve App is a next-generation marketplace focused on transforming how users buy and sell event tickets and resell costume reservations
projects.longDescription: The Lyve App is a next-generation marketplace focused on transforming how users buy and sell event tickets and resell costume reservations. Designed with simplicity and efficiency in mind, The Lyve App streamlines these transactions with a 100% guarantee on both purchases and sales. Whether you're an event planner, a costume reservations sell, or a customer, the app ensures a hassle-free experience.

projects.title: College Cost Secrets
projects.description: A bootstrapped financial planning service helping US families reduce college costs
projects.longDescription: A bootstrapped financial planning service helping US families reduce college costs through SAI optimization and one-on-one consulting. Developed the subscriber dashboard, financial planning tools, and client portal using React and Next.js. The platform serves families that have collectively saved $100M in college expenses, with a Kevin Harrington endorsement and 15+ years of operation.

projects.title: Bookvid - Live Video Booking Marketplace
projects.description: Bookvid is a platform that facilitates the booking and managing of digital events and video sessions.
projects.longDescription: Bookvid is a platform that facilitates the booking and managing of digital events and video sessions. It allows users to create booking pages, schedule sessions, and receive automatic payments through integrations with popular payment (e.g., PayPal, Venmo) and calendar apps. Clients can self-schedule, and users are notified of bookings and payments, simplifying managing and monetizing virtual meetings. The platform supports both individual and group sessions and ensures secure, encrypted communication

projects.title: Gambling Recovery App - Yume
projects.description: Yume is an app designed to help individuals overcome gambling addiction.
projects.longDescription: Yume is an app designed to help individuals overcome gambling addiction. Delivered 10K+ users and 25%+ paying conversion rate within 3 months of launch. The app was acquired by National Debt Relief within 6 months. Built for iOS using React Native, Expo, Firebase, and Redux with full App Store release.
